title: The build is carved back up from one function where a piece earns a name
body:
`construct` in `libsufr/src/build.rs` was the whole build as one function from 1462051. 023778c split it in two. `construct` normalizes the text, derives the `Packing` and picks a `KeyScheme`, which is `UnmaskedKeys` or `MaskedKeys`. `build` runs the rest: it counts the buckets and cuts the partitions, writes the header and text, gathers and sorts each turn, and writes the LCP at each partition's start. `Packing` was named `PrefixEncoder` until 75d429b. `counting_sort`, `merge_sort`, `merge`, `find_lcp`, `cut_partitions`, `turns` and `sort_partition` are the functions around them. `partition.rs` and `sort.rs` are gone, and so is the `build/` directory.

What the flat function showed, for the carving order, with what is left at 1b1ecd0:

- `merge_sort` takes 6 arguments and `merge` takes 7. Each takes the text, four slices and the LCP cache, and `merge` also takes `mid`. At 1462051 they took 9 and 10, which also counted the mask, the cap and the N runs.
- The text scan appeared four times: count and gather, each with and without a mask. It is now `count_chunk` and `gather_chunk`, generic over `KeyScheme`, each with a copy compiled for BMI2.
- The alphabet was matched in four places: `normalize`, `keep_table`, the N-run check and the header. The N-run check went with `--allow-ambiguity` in 3944856, so three places are left.
- `first_suffixes` and `last_suffixes` are carried out of the turn loop only for the boundary LCPs.

## Proposal

Carve a piece out of `construct` only where it earns a name: recursion, use from two places, a test that wants to call it, or a step with more than one implementation chosen at runtime. A step gets its own file only in that last case. Each carve is one commit, pinned by the fixtures and the oracle sweep, with the benchmark board when a hot loop moves.

## Rejected

Bundling the arguments of `sort_partitions` and `merge_sort` into structs, one for the comparison settings and one for the build state. `sort_partitions` is a function that 1462051 folded into `construct`. The bundling made the calls short and moved the arguments without reducing them, so the module was no simpler.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/fdde2c6d
notes.text: State at 1995d7c: construct still runs the pipeline in phases, and the pieces carved since the flatten are sort_partition and sort_masked_partition (two implementations of one step, chosen once per partition), count_masked and gather_masked with their bmi2 wrappers, and the encoder's windows_at, roll_windows and compact. The build-time cap is gone (b3f9104), the merge sort has no mask argument (cabe70c), and normalize and find_n_ranges are parallel passes. Still in construct: the two unmasked scan arms, the header literal, the first_suffixes and last_suffixes vectors and the turn loop. merge_sort and merge take 9 and 10 arguments.
